purpose: 新材质适配原网格与原UV；镜头、坐标和物理保持换肤前基线

prompts.name: uv-coral-story
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: opaque square UV texture for an EXISTING 3D mobile-game building mesh. Image 1 is the EXACT texture-layout edit target; Image 2 is STYLE ONLY.
Primary request: apply the approved sunlit miniature-city materials and palette to Image 1 while preserving every UV island, boundary, window/door position, rectangular region and small detail's coordinates. This must map to the original mesh without any geometry or UV changes. Replace yellow wall panels with warm ivory ceramic/stone; recolor the narrow structural vertical strips coral-orange, keep pale gray surrounding wall blocks softly ivory. Repaint BOTH matching upper window panels with sea-blue reflective glass, warm tiny pendant lamp and a small indoor plant, thin brass balcony railing following the existing black railing positions. Bottom-left large yellow UV island becomes warm ivory, its two small brown squares stay precisely positioned but become muted brass. Lower-right purple filler and circle remain precisely located; mute to pale warm gray/cream.
CRITICAL: output ONLY the entire flat square UV texture image, same composition, edge-to-edge; no model render, perspective, exploded view, borders, labels or text. Do not rearrange, crop, merge or delete any UV region. Keep architectural lines perpendicular and existing shape geometry unchanged. Soft dimensional detail and broad readable surfaces matching the sunlit reference, no pixel blocks, no gritty weathering. Target output 1024x1024 or larger square; it will be uniformly downsampled to the original 384x384. Background is OPAQUE everywhere; no transparency.

prompts.name: uv-ground
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: flat opaque square ground UV material texture for an existing 3D mobile game mesh. Image 1 is the EXACT UV texture edit target, Image 2 is STYLE ONLY.
Primary request: Repaint ONLY the ground-material colors to match the approved sunlit ivory/coral miniature city. Preserve every existing UV-region boundary, rectangle, stripe, gradient direction and small patch at its exact coordinates. The top roughly 36% grayscale blocks become warm ivory/cream ceramic and pale neutral stone, keeping their gentle value gradients and bevels. The large lower ochre-brown field becomes light sunlit sandstone/pavement (#F4E7D0), with a very subtle warm shade at its top. Every near-black patch becomes a muted warm taupe shadow (#CBBFA8), never black. Right-side brown swatches become ivory/taupe stone with the same region shapes. Use restrained smooth material shading, no new objects, windows, trees, perspective, dirt, gravel or markings. This is a UV palette, not a scene. Full square edge-to-edge exact layout, opaque pixels everywhere, no frame/text/logo/watermark. Do not move, resize, crop or merge regions. Output square at least1024x1024; it will be uniformly downsampled to the original128x128.
